run_convert_model_cli: run the CLI to convert a causal LM model to sequence classification format
convert_with_2_way_softmax: convert a reranker model using two-way softmax method with true/false token weights
convert_with_no_post_processing: convert a reranker model using no_post_processing method with direct token weight mapping
convert_bge_reranker_model: convert BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-gemma to sequence classification with Yes token
convert_qwen_reranker_model: convert Qwen3-Reranker to sequence classification with no/yes token pair
